_about: Assigned abilities (COMBAT_ENGINE_PLAN.md 3.4a): the non-magical twin of assigned spells. One entry per ability; tools/gen_abilities.js writes the ability_facts_load lookup in web/mygame/scenes/combat_abilities.txt from it. kind is one of attack_variant, action, extra_attack, on_hit_rider, trait. uses is a number per fight, or "unlimited". An extra_attack's weapon is "own" (the body's own weapon: its die, damage type and bonus, a cornered archer's sidearm) or "offhand" (a second weapon, given by damage_dice_sides and damage_type). An action names its range bands (range_min, range_max: 0 Engaged to 3 Long), its chance (1-100) and, for a hit, a condition with its escape_dc and src. An attack_variant replaces some plain attacks (chance): its own die, damage bonus and type, at the body's attack bonus without its ability modifier (atk_bonus minus dmg_bonus), and on a hit the named condition (today a label: disadvantage on the target's next d20, and Pinned, Hobbled and Off-Balance also restrict movement). A type's default ability sits in slot 3. An on_hit_rider adds to every hit: a damage packet of its own (damage_dice_sides, damage_bonus, damage_type), an effect (effect "stun": the target loses its next turn, named by effect_name and effect_icon), or both. A slot takes the first rider damage and the first stun among its abilities. A trait is a passive rule the engine asks about by id (combat_abilities.txt ability_has_trait); it has no fields of its own.

multiattack.name: Multiattack
multiattack.desc: After its first attack, it attacks again with the same weapon: the same die, damage type and attack bonus, without the special move. Melee or ranged.

offhand_knife.name: Off-hand Knife
offhand_knife.desc: After its first attack, a quick stab with a knife in the other hand: a d4 piercing strike at the same attack bonus. (Captain Trent's long blade and knife.)

net.name: Net
net.desc: Thrown instead of an attack, at a target at Close or Mid-Range: an attack roll with the body's own attack bonus against AC. A hit restrains the target (Break Free: a DC 10 Strength check). Once per fight. Not used on a target already restrained.

feint.name: Feint
feint.desc: Some of its attacks (30%) are this lighter move instead: a d4 slashing blow at its attack bonus without its ability modifier, and a hit leaves the target Off-Guard. (The swordsman's default.)

bleeding_cut.name: Bleeding Cut
bleeding_cut.desc: Some of its attacks (30%) are this lighter move instead: a d4 slashing blow at its attack bonus without its ability modifier, and a hit leaves the target Bleeding. (The axeman's default.)

poisoned_blade.name: Poisoned Blade
poisoned_blade.desc: Some of its attacks (30%) are this lighter move instead: a d4 piercing blow at its attack bonus without its ability modifier, and a hit leaves the target Poisoned. (The knifeman's default.)

dazing_blow.name: Dazing Blow
dazing_blow.desc: Some of its attacks (30%) are this lighter move instead: a d4 bludgeoning blow at its attack bonus without its ability modifier, and a hit leaves the target Dazed. (The maceman's default.)

pinning_thrust.name: Pinning Thrust
pinning_thrust.desc: Some of its attacks (30%) are this lighter move instead: a d4 piercing blow at its attack bonus without its ability modifier, and a hit leaves the target Pinned. (The spearman's default.)

hook_and_pull.name: Hook and Pull
hook_and_pull.desc: Some of its attacks (30%) are this lighter move instead: a d4 bludgeoning blow at its attack bonus without its ability modifier, and a hit leaves the target Off-Balance. (The hookman's default.)

hobbling_shot.name: Hobbling Shot
hobbling_shot.desc: Some of its attacks (25%) are this lighter move instead: a d4 piercing blow at its attack bonus without its ability modifier, and a hit leaves the target Hobbled. (The archer's default.)

blinding_stone.name: Blinding Stone
blinding_stone.desc: Some of its attacks (25%) are this lighter move instead: a d2 bludgeoning blow at its attack bonus without its ability modifier, and a hit leaves the target Blinded. (The slinger's default.)

venom.name: Venom
venom.desc: Every hit also deals 1d4 poison, its own damage packet (resisted on its own, doubled on a crit). (The Longshade venomous snake, the silt-conduit giant viper.)

venom_laced_claws.name: Venom-Laced Claws
venom_laced_claws.desc: Every hit also deals 1d2+3 poison, its own damage packet. (The dev hub's venom-laced lacedon.)

stunning_blow.name: Stunning Blow
stunning_blow.desc: A hit (or a failed save, for a save attack) stuns the target: it loses its next turn. No story foe holds it yet.

undead_fortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
undead_fortitude.desc: When the player's damage drops it to 0 HP, it makes a Constitution save (DC 5 + the damage) and stays up at 1 HP on a success, unless the damage is radiant or the blow was a critical hit. Every time it reaches 0 HP. (The zombie's default.)
